parsed.post: The last experiment with a higher learning rate regressed (1.013 vs 0.994). It seems the model is sensitive to the LR/Depth balance. Reverting to the best commit (cf5742e) and will now focus on increasing the ASPECT_RATIO and tweaking WEIGHT_DECAY to improve regularization.
parsed.description: Reverting to best commit and increasing ASPECT_RATIO to 64 while introducing a small WEIGHT_DECAY to improve generalization.
